simple.summary: שִׁיחוֹר (Shîychôwr) means Shichor , a stream of Egypt First listed occurrence: 1Chr 13 5.

definitions.full: H7883. Shichor שִׁיחוֺר proper name, of a river on border of Egypt, probably east branch of Nile ; — ׳הַשּׁ Josh 13:3 , ׳שׁ מִצְרַיִם 1Chr 13:5 ; clearly = Nile, שִׁחֹר זֶרַע Isa 23:3 (|| קְצִיר יְאוֺר ), שִׁחוֺר מֵי Jer 2:18 ; compare Dl Pa 311 Wilson Hast. DB SHIHOR (usually derived from I. שׁחר , as black water , but doubtful).
definitions.rootNote: or שִׁחוֹר ; or שִׁחֹר ; probably from 7835 ; dark , i.e. turbid ;
